# binary-editor test fixtures

Committed fixtures owned by `binary-editor`'s tests. Most fixtures the test suite uses are real game files
sourced elsewhere (committed Fallout protos under `client/testFixture/proto/`, the ITM/MAP samples, and the
vendored mod trees under `external/`); this directory holds only fixtures that have to be manufactured
because no real file exists.

## `scenery-elevator.synthetic.pro`

A synthetic Fallout scenery proto of subtype 2 (elevator), used by `layout-sync.test.ts` to exercise the
`scenery.elevator` layout variant.

Why synthetic: Fallout 2's shipped data, and every vendored mod under `external/` (1960 protos scanned),
contains zero scenery protos of subtype 2. In-game elevators are driven by map scripts, not an
elevator-subtype scenery proto, so the subtype is defined by the format but never instantiated by real data.
Without a fixture, the variant's two fields (`elevatorProperties.elevatorType` / `elevatorLevel`) would go
unverified by the sync test.

Provenance: generated by `generate-scenery-elevator.mts` from a real door proto
(`client/testFixture/proto/scenery/00000008.pro`) by round-tripping it through the codec's canonical JSON
snapshot, flipping the scenery subtype 0 (door) -> 2 (elevator), and swapping the door section for an
elevator section. The generator asserts the emitted bytes parse cleanly back to `scenery.elevator`.

Regenerate with:

```bash
pnpm exec tsx binary-editor/test/fixtures/generate-scenery-elevator.mts
```
